cases.slab: core 1.5 um, eps 4 in cladding eps 2.085136, y invariant, x open at +-4.5 um, z open at +-4 um, core continued through both z faces (fd-mode-source.md Setup S)
cases.straight: TE0 launched +z from z = -2 um, pulse centred at 1.55 um, frequency_sigma_hz 1.5e13; mode readouts at z = +1, +2 (forward) and -3 um (backward), at 1.45, 1.55, 1.65 um
cases.joint: core 1.5 um for z < 0 and 1.0 um for z > 0 (fd-mode-source.md S5); T read at z = +2 um in the narrow core, R at z = -1 um, at 1.55 um
cases.pml: the slab core run into a 0.6 um and a 1.2 um absorbing layer; reflected TE0 power at 1.55 um
cases.beam: vacuum, waist 1.5 um (1/e amplitude radius), wavelength 1.0 um, TE, focus at the origin, source plane z = -4 um (fd-gaussian-beam.md Setup B); back-radiation at 0.95, 1.0, 1.05 um; Gouy phase on the axis relative to the axial wave, largest difference from the exact angular spectrum over z in [-3, 3] um
cases.focal: waist 1.0 um, glass eps 2.25 for z > -1 um, source z = -2.5 um, focus declared at z = +0.5 um (fd-gaussian-beam.md G3); on-axis intensity peak in the glass

oracles.source: exact slab dispersion relation; continuum mode matching and exact angular spectrum as written in tests/fdtd/test_fd_mode_source.py and tests/fdtd/test_fd_gaussian_beam.py

inputs.keys: tool__quantity; spacing keys in um (Meep resolution 20, 40, 80 per um); lists follow the three wavelengths of the case

outcomes.matched: geometry, wavelengths, spacings, Courant number, polarization, readout planes; ratios only (FDTDX unit mode power has no area factor)
outcomes.not_matched: each tool's own mode solver, source and readout; Meep's subpixel averaging; FDTDX's Gaussian source focuses on its own plane (beam row is a variant, focal case not run); Wavebit's absorber row is D1, an initial-field launch, not the other tools' readout
outcomes.reference_self_check: Meep's and FDTDX's absorber values do not change when the layer is doubled, so they are a floor of their readout and are recorded as such
outcomes.failed_or_discarded: none discarded; every run that finished is recorded
outcomes.not_run: FDTDX focal-shift case (cannot be set up); FDTDX absorber case at 0.025 um; Wavebit butt joint at 0.0125 um
